acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce in a fresh plain clone of a lane branch and name the failing step
local-outcome is produced on a clean dogfood-finish, or the refusal carries the underlying error
A test covers the failure path
body: Every lane on 2026-10-21 (PRs #1453, #1454, #1455, #1456) reported a local-outcome NOT_PRODUCED row with reason record-index-failed on the prepare and bind passes of make dogfood-finish, even when check and seal passed. Expected: local-outcome is produced, or the reason names the failing index step and its error. Actual: a constant NOT_PRODUCED row on every lane, so the outcome evidence is never recorded.

title: dogfood-finish: local-outcome is NOT_PRODUCED with record-index-failed on every prepare and bind pass
